604826.title: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
604826.summary:
In Tsukuyomi, a virtual world filled with dreams and hopes, the stage is set for girls to meet—and part.
In the near future, 17-year-old Iroha Sakayori attends a competitive high school in Tokyo, juggling classes and part-time work. She relaxes by watching Yachiyo, the administrator and hugely popular streamer of the virtual space Tsukuyomi. Anyone there can create an avatar and express themselves freely. Iroha supports her idol Yachiyo and earns a little spending money in battle games.
One day, on her way home from school, Iroha discovers an RGB utility pole glowing in rainbow colors. Inside is a baby. Unable to leave her behind, Iroha takes her home—only to watch her rapidly grow into a girl about her own age.
“Could you actually be Princess Kaguya?”
The grown-up Kaguya is willful and demanding. At her request, Iroha helps her become a streamer in Tsukuyomi. Iroha produces the music and Kaguya sings, and their partnership gradually brings them closer. Neither realizes that an ominous presence is approaching to take Kaguya back to the moon.
This is a story of Princess Kaguya unlike any seen before.
604826.note: The biggest surprise at the start of 2026, born of three years of dedication by Shingo Yamashita. Hand-drawn Japanese animation at its finest—a treasure for anyone who loves animation.

464376.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
464376.summary:
Girls who couldn't win the hearts of the people they love: the “losing heroines.”
Anna Yanami, the food-loving childhood-friend heroine.
Lemon Yakishio, the energetic athletic heroine.
Chika Komari, the shy, small-animal-like heroine.
Surrounded by these slightly imperfect losing heroines, a fresh and chaotic tale of youthful romantic defeat begins.
Shine even brighter through defeat, losing heroines!
464376.note: It gave us Anna Yanami, one of the most beloved anime heroines of recent years. A feast for animation fans, full of the feeling of youth and a striking expression of Japanese coming-of-age aesthetics and philosophy.

518519.title: One Piece Fan Letter
518519.summary: Two years after the Summit War, a young admirer of Nami embarks on a small adventure in the Sabaody Archipelago. Adapted from the official spin-off novel One Piece novel Straw Hat Stories, it tells stories about the Straw Hat crew as seen through the eyes of ordinary people.
518519.note: A love letter to One Piece fans. Essential viewing!

431767.title: Girls Band Cry
431767.summary:
Pour every feeling into it: anger, joy, and sadness.
A second-year high school student drops out and heads to Tokyo alone, hoping to get into university. Another girl has been betrayed by her friends and doesn't know what to do. A third, abandoned by her parents, works part-time in the city to survive.
The world keeps betraying us. Nothing ever seems to go the way we want. But we still want to love something. We still believe there is somewhere we belong.
And so, we sing.
431767.note: The era of fierce competition among girls' band anime is here.

531159.title: Food for the Soul
531159.summary:
Cute × delicious = the ultimate comfort food.
An everyday story about five girls who have just started university.
They love good food, want to have fun together, and might even put a little effort into studying. Let's enjoy university life to the fullest!
531159.note: A new high point for fans of cute, comforting anime!

501958.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle, Chapter 1: Akaza Returns
501958.summary:
Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps to turn his demon sister Nezuko back into a human.
With Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira, he battles many demons, growing stronger and deepening their friendship.
He also fights alongside the Corps' highest-ranking swordsmen, the Hashira: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku in Mugen Train, Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui in the Entertainment District, and Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji in the Swordsmith Village.
As the Corps undertakes joint Hashira Training for the coming decisive battle, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at its headquarters, the Ubuyashiki estate. The Hashira and Tanjiro rush to save their leader, but Muzan sends them into a mysterious space.
They have fallen into Infinity Castle, the demons' stronghold.
The final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons begins.
501958.note: Whether or not Demon Slayer is your favorite, it represents the highest level of hand-drawn 2D animation in this era.

400602.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
400602.summary:
After a ten-year adventure, the mage Frieren and the hero Himmel defeat the Demon King and bring peace to the world.
An elf who can live for over a thousand years, Frieren promises to see her companions again and sets out on her own.
Fifty years later, she visits Himmel. She has barely changed, but he has grown old and is nearing the end of his life.
After witnessing his death, Frieren regrets never truly understanding the human heart and begins a journey to learn.
Many people and experiences await her along the way.
400602.note: After Bocchi the Rock!, Keiichiro Saito once again shows what a truly exceptional director can do.

376703.title: The Idolmaster Cinderella Girls U149
376703.summary: One summer afternoon, Arisu Tachibana enters a room at a talent agency, where she meets eight girls of different ages and personalities. The room is called the Third Entertainment Division. In this small, cluttered space, girls under 149 cm tall hold on to big dreams. Their story as idols begins here. And their producer will arrive like a prince on a white horse! …Actually, he is a short young man who has only just become a producer. A rookie with little more than enthusiasm and girls starting from zero: they struggle with the difficulty of work, laugh together the next day, and keep climbing hand in hand. Will Arisu and her friends reach the stage they dream of? This is a new story from The Idolmaster Cinderella Girls. “Hey, what will we be like when we grow up?”
376703.note: Love is always the greatest creative force.

428735.title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!
428735.summary:
“Will you be in a band with me for the rest of our lives?”

As the spring of their first year of high school draws to a close, everyone at Haneoka Girls' Academy seems to be in a band. Anon, who enrolled late, starts looking for bandmates to fit in with her class. She learns that Tomori, the girl known as Haneoka's mysterious outsider, hasn't joined a band, and can't help inviting her.

Our music—our cries—is bruised and awkward.
It's all right to be lost. Even lost, we'll keep moving forward.
428735.note: A defining work of a new era of Japanese animation, opening the age of girls' band anime. A major step in bringing a niche culture to a wider audience.

362335.title: Gridman Universe
362335.summary:
At Tsutsujidai High School, Yuta Hibiki repeatedly sketches the Gridman he remembers in a notebook after class, then erases him. A girl once created and destroyed this world. A hyper agent from another dimension, the monsters she created with hearts of their own, and Yuta's friends saved her.
Now in his second year and in a different class from Rikka, Yuta decides to confess his feelings. Their peaceful everyday life begins to crumble with a thunderous roar.
When danger strikes, Gridman appears: “The balance of this world is about to collapse.”
The crimson dragon Dyna Rex, Gridman's allies the Neon Genesis Junior High Students, and Yomogi Asanaka and others from another world soon arrive before Yuta.
Keeping his feelings for Rikka hidden, Yuta enters another extraordinary adventure.
362335.note: A textbook example of how to make a work for the fans.

424379.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You
424379.summary:
After reaching 100 romantic rejections in middle school, Rentaro Aijo visits a shrine, hoping to finally find a girlfriend in high school. The god of love tells him that he will meet 100 soulmates there.
But according to the god, anyone who meets their destined partner will die if they don't fall in love and find happiness together.
Soulmates keep appearing one after another. What will Rentaro do? What will become of his 100 girlfriends?
424379.note: Even the most familiar premise can make you feel wonderfully, sincerely happy.

378862.title: ONIMAI: I'm Now Your Sister!
378862.summary:
One day, shut-in Mahiro Oyama wakes up to discover that he has become a girl. As he struggles to believe the beautiful girl in the mirror is him, his younger sister Mihari—a scientist who skipped ahead to university—explains that she slipped an unusual drug into his drink.
Mahiro has spent the past two years at home playing adult games, working only when he absolutely has to. Suddenly living as a girl, he has no idea how to deal with bathrooms, baths, skirts, bras, and the rest. He also meets Mihari's former middle-school classmate Kaede Hozuki and her younger sister Momiji.
Mahiro's daily life grows livelier. Amid these continuing trials, what fate awaits this former big brother?
378862.note: With enough care, even the simplest material can become an exceptionally well-directed work.

146598.title: 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim
146598.summary:
The ATLUS × VANILLAWARE team behind Odin Sphere and Dragon's Crown takes on a new science-fiction adventure. Thirteen boys and girls whose paths cross across time pilot giant robots called Sentinels in a final battle for humanity's survival.

All thirteen characters are protagonists. Each has a story told from their own perspective; only by seeing them all can you uncover the truth behind their doomed fate.

The game has three parts: Destruction for combat, Remembrance for the story, and Analysis for a deeper review of the events. Together they offer different ways to enjoy 13 Sentinels.

Remembrance: solve each character's mysteries. Think about keywords gathered in conversation to transform them, use them on other people, or discover new ones. Each protagonist has closely connected characters and dedicated chapters; as the story advances, hidden relationships and branching points emerge.

Analysis: revisit the facts and search for the truth. The archives record the detailed elements of the game's world. Replay scenes you have seen and examine the mysterious story repeatedly from a broader perspective.

Destruction: pilot the Sentinels to face a global crisis. Organize four types—melee, all-purpose, long-range, and flight support—to fight the mysterious kaiju attacking the city in fast-paced tactical battles.
146598.note: A story like no other. My number-one choice of games I wish I could forget and experience again for the first time.

482314.title: Gakuen Idolmaster
482314.summary:
A new entry in The Idolmaster series, launched in 2024.
Enroll at Hatsuboshi Academy, a school for aspiring idols, and work as a producer with candidates who each have their own charms and challenges.
Bring out their talents through school life and help them shine on the stage of their dreams!
482314.note: Come be a producer with me!

137458.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
137458.summary:
FINAL FANTASY VII, released for PlayStation in 1997, returns with new elements and a fresh retelling. Command-based battles blend with intuitive action for richer strategy. Technology unavailable twenty years ago brings the world of FFVII to life.

This is a remake of the 1997 original. Based on the story up to the escape from Midgar and expanded with original material, it is the first installment in a planned multi-part series.
137458.note: A pure expression of level-design craft. Older games really did have remarkable depth.

390508.title: Ys X: Nordics
390508.summary:
We are all born free. As we grow older, outside forces gradually take away that birthright, until we begin to long for freedom again. Yet we can return to it at any time.
—From Adol Christin's Paradise Lost of the Northerners

The story is set in Obelia Gulf, a northern sea scattered with islands of every size. Young adventurer Adol Christin encounters the seafaring Normans. What are the immortal Griegr attacking the region's inhabitants?
The new Cross Action system lets you switch freely between Solo Mode, where your partner attacks and supports automatically, and Duo Mode, where you control both characters together in exchanges of offense and defense against powerful foes.
You can also sail a ship across the sea. Use charts to explore the waters and fight enemy ships, adding new elements to the adventure at the heart of Ys.
Mana Actions further expand your freedom to explore fields and dungeons.
Ys X: Nordics tells a new adventure in Obelia Gulf with a young Adol, from the team behind Ys VIII and Ys IX.
390508.note: I've been a Ys fan for years. This entry is fun to play and a very welcoming starting point for newcomers.

112339.title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA
112339.summary:
Seiren Island, the eternally cursed isle, lies in the Gaete Sea.
A new adventure for young Adol begins on this remote island forgotten by history.
Explore wide-open fields and an entire island recreated in 3D with a free camera.
Enjoy fast-paced party battles with simple controls, free movement, dashing, and jumping.
Build a Castaway Village, unite the survivors, and expand and develop your base.
112339.note: The high point of the Ys series, and one of gaming's great stories. The visuals have aged, but it is absolutely worth playing.

62229.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
62229.summary:
In a vast world, where you go and what you do are entirely up to you. Hunt wild animals to survive, defeat monsters, or visit the sights. Run, swim, glide, and climb through a boundless adventure. On Nintendo Switch, you can play on the television at home and continue on the go; even how you play is free.

Story
A disaster known as the Great Calamity destroyed the kingdom of Hyrule.
One hundred years later, Link wakes from a long sleep in underground ruins and steps out into the world, guided by a mysterious voice.

290114.title: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition
290114.summary:
Xenoblade Chronicles is reborn on Nintendo Switch.
This is a story about changing the future and connecting to it.
When the Mechon attack Shulk's home and kill his childhood friend, he begins a journey through a vast world of conflict between humans and machines.
With the legendary Monado, Shulk can see the future. He anticipates danger and works with his companions to overcome it and forge a new path.
The bodies of gods have become immense landscapes. The story takes you across their legs and arms and even inside them, with very different scenery in each place.

Ten years after the Wii RPG developed by MONOLITH SOFTWARE INC. in 2010, this remaster returns on Switch. It preserves the original story and adds Future Connected, giving returning players a new adventure with Shulk.
Enjoy a beautiful, expansive adventure anywhere on Nintendo Switch.
The Collection Mode and amiibo features from the New Nintendo 3DS version are not included.
290114.note: One of the greatest stories in games—and in screen storytelling more broadly. A must-experience work!

234026.title: Slay the Spire
234026.summary: A single-player deck-building game that brings together card games and roguelikes. Craft a unique deck, meet countless strange creatures, discover powerful relics, and conquer the Spire!
234026.note: The pinnacle of roguelike deck-building, imitated by countless games that followed.

477760.title: Balatro
477760.summary:
Balatro is a poker-inspired deck-builder about creating powerful synergies and winning big.

Endless possibilities, easy to learn and hard to master.
Combine valid poker hands with unique Jokers to build different synergies and strategies. Earn enough chips to beat the blinds while discovering hidden bonus hands and decks. Find every possible advantage to reach the ultimate blind and defeat the final stakes.

An ultimate poker-style journey. Every draw, discard, and Joker can transform your run. A deep campaign offers eight difficulty levels, alongside challenges, daily runs, and custom game modes.
477760.note: A pinnacle of independent game development.

113290.title: Sabbat of the Witch
113290.summary: Sabbat of the Witch (Japanese title: Sanoba Witch) is a romance visual novel developed and published by Yuzusoft, released for Windows PC on February 27, 2015. NekoNyan published the English version on October 27, 2018, through Steam, its own store, and other platforms, with a physical edition as well. HIKARI FIELD published the Chinese version on Steam on July 21, 2023—the familiar “0721” date for Yuzusoft fans.
113290.note: The game that introduced me to visual novels. Essential for fans of “Hua-ge”!
